display.purpose: The main page and sign-in headings.

shadows.name: editor-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift the active application editor above the flat ledger.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Show focus on form and filter controls.

motion.name: button-state
motion.value: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease
motion.purpose: Keep button hover and press feedback brief; disable it for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral action for adding and saving, with appearance-specific button ink.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--button-ink); font: 700 14px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for canceling or retrying.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); border-color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-button-secondary { background: var(--field); } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: A compact labeled field with appearance-specific fill and cyan focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Resume Upload
components.description: A dashed file selection button distinct from the save action.
components.css: .ds-upload { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 39px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px dashed #96ac9f; border-radius: 7px; background: #f6faf5; color: #285c49; font: 700 13px/1.4 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload:hover { background: #eaf4e9; } .ds-upload:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Existing shared header preview; the desktop uses its sidebar and circular zebra raster.
components.html:
PM Application Tracker
Private workspace
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 76px; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 4vw, 68px); background: var(--forest); color: #f8f7ef; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 690; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-account { color: #d3e1d9; font-size: 13px; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-topbar { min-height: 67px; } .ds-brand { font-size: 14px; } .ds-account { display: none; } }

components.name: Statistic Band
components.description: Ruled paper cells give application totals a stable reading rhythm.
components.css: .ds-stat-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding: 23px 25px 22px; } .ds-stat + .ds-stat { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-stat span { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-stat strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 660; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-stat { padding: 18px; } }

components.name: Application Record
components.description: A ruled list record that becomes a labeled two-column card on mobile.
components.html:
Senior Product ManagerExample CompanyView listing
AppliedSep 28, 2026
ResumePM resume.pdf
components.css: .ds-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1.3fr; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-record:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-record-role strong, .ds-record-role span, .ds-record-role a { display: block; } .ds-record-role strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-record-role a { margin-top: 7px; color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-record-role a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-record-role a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-record-detail small { display: none; } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-record { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px 20px; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-record-role { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .ds-record-detail small { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } }

components.name: Status Select
components.description: A native select with a tint that reflects the current hiring stage.
components.html: <select class="ds-status" aria-label="Application status" data-status="Interview scheduled"><option>Applied</option><option>Heard back</option><option selected>Interview scheduled</option><option>Rejected</option></select>
components.css: .ds-status { width: 172px; height: 33px; padding: 0 25px 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; outline: 0; font: 720 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-status[data-status="Applied"] { color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--canvas); } .ds-status[data-status="Heard back"] { color: #855d1e; background: #fcf0d8; } .ds-status[data-status="Interview scheduled"] { color: #1f674d; background: #e0f3e7; } .ds-status[data-status="Rejected"] { color: #9a4a3c; background: #fae9e5; } .ds-status:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-status { height: 44px; } } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-status { width: 100%; } } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-status[data-status="Applied"] { background: var(--surface-hover); } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-status[data-status="Heard back"] { color: #f0d7a7; background: #55472b; } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-status[data-status="Interview scheduled"] { color: #b9e3c4; background: #2d4a38; } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-status[data-status="Rejected"] { color: #f1beb3; background: #513832; }

components.name: Match Score
components.description: A numeric percentage plus a short track keeps match strength readable without relying on color.
components.css: .ds-match { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-match strong { min-width: 35px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-match-track { display: block; width: 48px; height: 5px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #e2e9e1; } .ds-match-track span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #2d8864; }

components.name: Job Importance Row
components.description: Editable requirement with separate read-only estimated importance to the job. Synthetic preview data.
components.html: 96%
components.css: .ds-priority-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 52px 26px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-priority-field { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 38px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; outline: 0; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-priority-field:focus, .ds-priority-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); } .ds-priority-badge { padding: 5px 2px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--cyan-wash); color: var(--cyan); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; } .ds-priority-badge.ds-unrated { background: var(--canvas); color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-priority-remove { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); cursor: pointer; } .ds-priority-remove:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-priority-remove:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-priority-remove:disabled, .ds-priority-field:disabled { opacity: .58; }

narrative.overview:
The app should feel like a dependable working ledger for a busy job search. Cream paper and fine neutral rules keep rows readable, while a charcoal sidebar gives the workspace a clear identity. The approved detailed sunglasses zebra supplies the circular brand mark. Coral points to the next useful action, and cyan identifies information and focus.

The interface stays compact enough for several entries a day. The existing serif and platform sans-serif hierarchy, native controls, and left navigation remain the working grammar. The full striped zebra, cyan lenses, and yellow mane provide expression inside the icon; the surrounding workspace keeps application data and editable role priorities easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper surfaces on a muted canvas, with a charcoal sidebar.
The full circular zebra as the recognizable app identity.
Coral actions and cyan information and focus accents.
Strong hierarchy through typography and spacing, with light borders between data.
Compact native controls with visible focus treatment.
A table on wide screens that becomes readable record cards on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Color Roles Rule
rules.body: Use coral for deliberate actions and cyan for information and focus. Keep semantic green notices and hiring stages, amber warnings, and match-strength colors in their existing roles, with readable text and values.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Reserve expressive serif type for Settings and setup headings; application data stays sans-serif.

rules.name: The Active Editor Rule
rules.body: Apply the ambient shadow to the open editor only; resting data surfaces remain flat.

dos: Do use the sidebar to identify Plan and Applications, keeping the workspace and its data compact.
Do keep controls legible and preserve 44px targets for mobile row actions and status changes.
Do pair match-track color with a numeric percentage, and pair status tint with readable text.
Do show visible keyboard focus and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add shadows to every row or metric; the editor is the elevated surface.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate match strength or status.
Don't compress application records into an unreadable mobile table; use labeled record cards.
